jp-20260926-news-1.title: Nikkei Average rises for 5th consecutive day, recovering 66,000 yen level for the first time since September 7; AI and semiconductor stocks lead the market despite U.S. interest rates reaching highest level in about 20 years

segments.src: 25日の東京株式市場で、日経平均株価は前日比850円高の6万6364円で取引を終え、5営業日連続で上昇しました。6万6000円台の回復は9月7日以来です。
segments.tr: In the Tokyo stock market on the 25th, the Nikkei Stock Average ended trading up 850 yen from the previous day at 66,364 yen, rising for the fifth consecutive business day. This is the first recovery of the 66,000 yen level since September 7.

segments.src: 一方、米国では5年債利回りが約20年ぶりに5%台へ乗せ、日米の金利が急速に上昇しています。通常、金利の上昇は株式市場の重荷になりやすいとされます。それでも株価が上昇したのはなぜか。本記事では、この日の相場を動かした要因を、公表されている情報の範囲で整理します。
segments.tr: Meanwhile, in the U.S., the 5-year Treasury yield has risen to the 5% range for the first time in about 20 years, and interest rates in both Japan and the U.S. are rising rapidly. Generally, rising interest rates tend to be a burden on the stock market. Why did stock prices still rise? This article organizes the factors that moved the market on this day within the scope of publicly available information.

segments.src: ## この日の相場のポイント
segments.tr: ## Key Points of the Market on This Day

segments.src: - 日経平均は850円高の6万6364円で5日続伸
segments.tr: - Nikkei Average rises for 5th consecutive day, up 850 yen at 66,364 yen

segments.src: - 6万6000円台の回復は9月7日以来
segments.tr: - Recovery of 66,000 yen level is the first since September 7

segments.src: - 米5年債利回りが約20年ぶりに5%台へ上昇し、日米で金利が上昇
segments.tr: - U.S. 5-year Treasury yield rises to the 5% range for the first time in about 20 years, with interest rates rising in both Japan and the U.S.

segments.src: - 半導体関連株が上昇し、相場を主導
segments.tr: - Semiconductor-related stocks rise, leading the market

segments.src: - 銀行株が上昇
segments.tr: - Banking stocks rise

segments.src: - 中間配当の権利取りを意識した買いも下支え
segments.tr: - Buying driven by awareness of interim dividend rights also provided support

segments.src: ## 5日続伸、6万6000円台を回復
segments.tr: ## Rising for 5th Consecutive Day, Recovering 66,000 Yen Level

segments.src: 日経平均の上げ幅は850円と大きく、前日の終値は6万5500円台だったことになります。連日の上昇で、9月上旬につけた水準を再び上回りました。
segments.tr: The Nikkei Average's gain was a large 850 yen, meaning the previous day's closing price was in the 65,500 yen range. With consecutive days of increases, it has once again exceeded the levels seen in early September.

segments.src: 短期間で大きく上昇した後は、利益確定の売りが出て値動きが荒くなることもあります。一方で、上昇局面では押し目を狙う買いが入りやすいという見方もあります。いずれにしても、この日の上昇が今後も続くとは限らない点には注意が必要です。
segments.tr: After rapid increases in a short period, profit-taking sales can sometimes emerge, making price movements volatile. On the other hand, there is also the view that buying targeting dips tends to enter during rising phases. In any case, caution is necessary as the rise on this day does not necessarily guarantee continuation.

segments.src: ## 米金利が約20年ぶりの高水準、それでも株が買われた理由
segments.tr: ## U.S. Interest Rates at Highest Level in About 20 Years, Yet Stocks Were Bought: Why?

segments.src: ### 米5年債利回りが5%台に
segments.tr: ### U.S. 5-Year Treasury Yield Enters 5% Range

segments.src: 米国の5年債利回りが約20年ぶりに5%台へ上昇しました。5年債の利回りは、政策金利の先行きに対する市場の見方を反映しやすいとされています。金利が高くなると、次のような影響が意識されやすくなります。
segments.tr: The U.S. 5-year Treasury yield rose to the 5% range for the first time in about 20 years. Yields on 5-year bonds are said to easily reflect market views on the future direction of policy interest rates. When interest rates become high, the following impacts tend to be noticed:

segments.src: - 企業の資金調達コストが増える
segments.tr: - Corporate financing costs increase

segments.src: - 債券など、株式以外の資産の魅力が相対的に高まる
segments.tr: - The relative attractiveness of non-stock assets such as bonds increases

segments.src: - 将来の利益を現在の価値に割り引く際の率が上がり、成長株の理論的な評価が下がりやすい
segments.tr: - The discount rate used to calculate future profits into present value rises, easily lowering the theoretical valuation of growth stocks

segments.src: そのため、金利上昇は本来、株式市場にとって逆風になりやすい材料です。この日の東京市場でも、日米の金利上昇は警戒材料として意識されていました。
segments.tr: Therefore, rising interest rates are inherently a potential headwind for the stock market. In the Tokyo market on this day as well, rising interest rates in Japan and the U.S. were recognized as a cautionary factor.

segments.src: ### 「金利より業績期待」が上回った構図
segments.tr: ### The Dynamic Where "Earnings Expectations Outweighed Interest Rates"

segments.src: それでも株価が上昇した背景には、AI（人工知能）関連の需要を追い風に、半導体関連企業の業績拡大への期待が根強いことがあるとみられます。金利上昇という逆風を、成長への期待が上回った形です。
segments.tr: The background behind the rising stock prices despite this is seen to be strong expectations for earnings expansion among semiconductor-related companies, fueled by demand related to AI (artificial intelligence). The headwind of rising interest rates was outweighed by expectations for growth.

segments.src: ただし、金利の水準が高いままで推移すれば、株式の評価には次第に影響が及ぶ可能性があります。今後の米国の経済指標や金融政策をめぐる発言は、引き続き注目されます。
segments.tr: However, if interest rate levels remain high, there is a possibility that it will gradually impact stock valuations. Future U.S. economic indicators and statements concerning monetary policy will continue to draw attention.

segments.src: ## 相場を押し上げた3つの要因
segments.tr: ## Three Factors That Pushed Up the Market

segments.src: ### 1. 半導体関連株の上昇
segments.tr: ### 1. Rise in Semiconductor-Related Stocks

segments.src: この日の相場を主導したのは、半導体関連株です。AIの普及に伴うデータセンター投資や、高性能な半導体への需要拡大が期待されており、半導体製造装置や関連部材を手がける企業にも関心が向かいやすい状況が続いています。
segments.tr: Semiconductor-related stocks led the market on this day. With data center investments accompanying the spread of AI and expanding demand for high-performance semiconductors expected, interest continues to be directed toward companies handling semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related materials.

segments.src: 日経平均は、値がさ株と呼ばれる株価水準の高い銘柄の影響を受けやすい指数です。そのため、半導体関連株が動くと指数全体に大きく反映されることがあります。指数の上昇が、幅広い銘柄の上昇を意味するとは限らない点にも留意が必要です。
segments.tr: The Nikkei Average is an index easily influenced by high-priced stocks known as values. Therefore, movements in semiconductor-related stocks can be largely reflected in the entire index. It is also important to note that a rise in the index does not necessarily mean a rise in a wide range of stocks.

segments.src: ### 2. 銀行株の上昇
segments.tr: ### 2. Rise in Banking Stocks

segments.src: 日本でも金利が上昇するなか、銀行株も買われました。一般に、金利が上がると貸出金利と預金金利の差である利ざやが拡大しやすく、銀行の収益にはプラスに働くとされます。金利上昇局面で銀行株に資金が向かう動きは、これまでもたびたびみられてきました。
segments.tr: Amid rising interest rates in Japan as well, banking stocks were also bought. Generally, when interest rates rise, the interest margin—the difference between lending and deposit rates—tends to widen, which is said to have a positive effect on bank earnings. Movements where funds flow into banking stocks during rising interest rate phases have been observed frequently in the past.

segments.src: ### 3. 中間配当の権利取り
segments.tr: ### 3. Interim Dividend Rights Acquisition

segments.src: 9月末は、3月期決算の企業の中間配当の権利確定時期にあたります。配当を受け取る権利を得るには、権利確定日の2営業日前にあたる「権利付き最終売買日」までに株式を保有している必要があります。そのため、この時期には配当を意識した買いが入りやすく、この日の相場を支えた一因とされています。
segments.tr: The end of September is the period for confirming interim dividend rights for companies with a March fiscal year-end. To acquire the right to receive dividends, investors must hold shares by the "ex-dividend date with rights," which falls two business days before the record date. Therefore, buying conscious of dividends tends to enter during this period, and it is considered one of the factors supporting the market on this day.

segments.src: なお、権利確定日を過ぎると、配当分だけ株価が下がる「権利落ち」が起きるのが一般的です。配当を受け取れても、株価の下落で差し引きの損益がマイナスになる場合もあります。
segments.tr: Additionally, once the record date passes, an "ex-dividend" drop typically occurs where the stock price falls by the dividend amount. Even if dividends are received, the net profit and loss may become negative due to the decline in stock prices.

segments.src: ## 今後の注目点
segments.tr: ## Points to Watch Moving Forward

segments.src: 今後の相場を見るうえでは、次のような点が焦点になりそうです。
segments.tr: When looking at the future market, the following points are likely to become focal points:

segments.src: - **米長期金利の動向**：5%台の定着か、低下に転じるかで、株式市場の受け止め方が変わる可能性があります。
segments.tr: - **Trends in U.S. Long-Term Interest Rates**: Whether the 5% range takes root or turns downward may change how the stock market perceives the situation.

segments.src: - **日米の金融政策**：政策金利の先行きをめぐる見方は、為替や株価に影響します。
segments.tr: - **Monetary Policy in Japan and the U.S.**: Views surrounding the future of policy interest rates affect foreign exchange and stock prices.

segments.src: - **半導体・AI関連の業績や需要動向**：期待が先行している分、決算や需要見通しの内容によって値動きが大きくなることがあります。
segments.tr: - **Earnings and Demand Trends in Semiconductor and AI-Related Sectors**: Because expectations have run ahead, price movements can become volatile depending on the contents of financial results and demand forecasts.

segments.src: - **権利落ち後の需給**：配当を意識した買いが一巡した後の値動きにも注意が必要です。
segments.tr: - **Supply and Demand After Ex-Dividend**: Attention is also necessary regarding price movements after buying driven by dividends has run its course.

segments.src: - **為替相場**：円相場の変動は、輸出企業を中心に業績見通しに影響します。
segments.tr: - **Foreign Exchange Market**: Fluctuations in the yen exchange rate affect earnings forecasts, centered on export companies.

segments.src: ## 個人が相場ニュースを読むときの心構え
segments.tr: ## Mindset for Individuals Reading Market News

segments.src: 株価の上昇が続くと、今後も上がるように感じるかもしれません。しかし、株価は経済指標や政策、海外情勢など多くの要因で変動します。
segments.tr: When stock price increases continue, it may feel like they will keep rising in the future. However, stock prices fluctuate due to many factors such as economic indicators, policies, and overseas situations.

segments.src: - 1日の上げ下げで判断せず、中長期の視点で確認する
segments.tr: - Do not judge based on single-day gains and losses; check from a medium-to-long-term perspective.

segments.src: - 指数の動きと、自分が関心のある企業や資産の動きは別物だと理解する
segments.tr: - Understand that index movements are different from the movements of companies and assets you are interested in.

segments.src: - 数字や解説は、取引所や企業の公式発表など一次情報で確認する
segments.tr: - Verify numbers and commentaries through primary sources such as official announcements from exchanges and companies.

segments.src: - 投資は自己資金の範囲で行い、最終的な判断はご自身で行う
segments.tr: - Conduct investments within the scope of your own funds and make final decisions yourself.

segments.src: ## まとめ
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: 25日の日経平均は850円高の6万6364円と5日続伸し、9月7日以来の6万6000円台を回復しました。米5年債利回りが約20年ぶりに5%台へ上昇するなど日米で金利が上がるなか、半導体関連株の上昇、銀行株高、中間配当の権利取りが相場を押し上げました。
segments.tr: The Nikkei Average on the 25th rose for the fifth consecutive day, up 850 yen to 66,364 yen, recovering the 66,000 yen level for the first time since September 7. Amid rising interest rates in Japan and the U.S., such as the U.S. 5-year Treasury yield rising to the 5% range for the first time in about 20 years, rises in semiconductor-related stocks, high banking stocks, and interim dividend rights acquisition pushed up the market.

segments.src: 金利上昇と株高が同時に進む局面では、先行きの不確実性も高まりやすくなります。今後も金利や為替、企業業績のニュースを丁寧に確認していくことが大切です。
segments.tr: In phases where rising interest rates and higher stock prices progress simultaneously, uncertainties for the future also tend to increase. It remains important to carefully check news concerning interest rates, foreign exchange, and corporate earnings moving forward.

segments.src: *本記事は、市場の動きを解説する情報提供を目的としたものであり、特定の銘柄や金融商品の売買を勧誘・推奨するものではありません。株価や指標の数値は執筆時点の情報に基づいており、正確性を保証するものではありません。投資に関する最終判断は、ご自身の責任で行ってください。*
segments.tr: *This article is intended to provide information explaining market movements and does not solicit or recommend the purchase or sale of specific stocks or financial products. Numerical values of stock prices and indicators are based on information at the time of writing and do not guarantee accuracy. Please make final investment decisions at your own risk.*

jp-20260926-news-3.title: Furusato Nozei: Cap on Solicitation Expenses to Drop to 47.5% or Less from October 1st—Is a "Last-Minute Donation" in Late September Really Worth It?

segments.src: ふるさと納税の制度が、2026年10月1日から変わります。自治体が寄付の募集に使える経費の上限が、これまでの「寄付額の50%以下」から「47.5%以下」へ引き下げられます。あわせて、返礼品の「地場産品」の基準も厳格化されます。
segments.tr: The Furusato Nozei (hometown tax donation) system will change starting October 1, 2026. The upper limit on expenses that local governments can use for donation solicitation will be lowered from the previous "50% or less of the donation amount" to "47.5% or less." Additionally, standards for "locally produced goods" as return gifts will be tightened.

segments.src: これを受けて、「9月中に寄付しないと損をする」といった声も聞かれます。しかし、駆け込みで寄付をすることが誰にとっても得になるとは限りません。この記事では、制度改正の中身を整理したうえで、9月中に寄付を済ませるべきかどうかを判断するための考え方をまとめます。
segments.tr: In response to this, some voices are saying, "You'll lose out if you don't donate during September." However, making a last-minute donation is not necessarily beneficial for everyone. This article outlines the details of the institutional revision and summarizes the thought process for deciding whether you should complete your donation in September.

segments.src: ## 何が変わるのか：自治体の「手元に残る割合」が引き上げられる
segments.tr: ## What Will Change: The Percentage "Remaining in the Hands" of Local Governments Will Increase

segments.src: 今回の改正の柱は、寄付額のうち自治体が実際に地域の事業などに使える割合を、段階的に高めることです。
segments.tr: The core of this revision is to gradually increase the proportion of the donation amount that local governments can actually use for regional projects and other activities.

segments.src: これまでは、返礼品の調達費、送料、広報費、決済手数料、ポータルサイトへの手数料、事務費といった「寄付の募集に要する費用」を、寄付額の50%以下に収めることが求められてきました（返礼品の調達費が寄付額の30%以下という、いわゆる「3割ルール」も別にあります）。
segments.tr: Until now, "expenses required for soliciting donations"—such as return gift procurement costs, shipping fees, public relations fees, payment processing fees, portal site fees, and administrative expenses—were required to be kept within 50% or less of the donation amount (there is also a separate "30% rule" stating that return gift procurement costs must be 30% or less of the donation amount).

segments.src: 改正後は、この募集経費の上限が47.5%以下になります。言い換えると、自治体の手元に残る割合を52.5%以上とする基準です。この割合は毎年10月に2.5ポイントずつ引き上げられ、2029年10月に60%以上（募集経費は40%以下）となる予定です。
segments.tr: After the revision, the cap on these solicitation expenses will become 47.5% or less. In other words, the standard is that the percentage remaining with the local government will be 52.5% or more. This percentage is scheduled to be raised by 2.5 points every October, reaching 60% or more (with solicitation expenses at 40% or less) by October 2029.

segments.src: | 時期 | 募集経費の上限 | 自治体の手元に残る割合 |
segments.tr: | Timing | Cap on Solicitation Expenses | Percentage Remaining for Local Gov |
| Current (~September 2026) | 50% or less | 50% or more |
| From October 2026 | 47.5% or less | 52.5% or more |
| From October 2027 | 45% or less | 55% or more |
| From October 2028 | 42.5% or less | 57.5% or more |
| From October 2029 | 40% or less | 60% or more |

segments.src: ※2027年10月以降の数値は、「毎年10月に2.5ポイントずつ引き上げ、2029年10月に60%」という段階的な引き上げの方針から整理したものです。最終的な内容は、総務省の告示などで確認してください。
segments.tr: ※Figures for October 2027 and later are organized based on the phased revision policy of "raising by 2.5 points every October, reaching 60% in October 2029." Please check final details in notifications from the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications.

segments.src: ### 1万円の寄付でイメージすると
segments.tr: ### Visualizing with a 10,000-Yen Donation

segments.src: 寄付額を1万円とした場合の目安は次のとおりです。
segments.tr: Estimated breakdowns when assuming a donation amount of 10,000 yen are as follows:

segments.src: - 現行：募集経費の上限は5,000円。返礼品の調達費が上限の3,000円なら、送料・手数料・広報費などに使える枠は2,000円
segments.tr: - Current: Cap on solicitation expenses is 5,000 yen. If the return gift procurement cost is the maximum of 3,000 yen, the budget available for shipping, fees, public relations, etc., is 2,000 yen

segments.src: - 2026年10月〜：募集経費の上限は4,750円。同じく返礼品が3,000円なら、その他の経費に使える枠は1,750円
segments.tr: - From October 2026: Cap on solicitation expenses is 4,750 yen. If the return gift is similarly 3,000 yen, the budget available for other expenses is 1,750 yen

segments.src: - 2029年10月〜：募集経費の上限は4,000円。同じく返礼品が3,000円なら、その他の経費に使える枠は1,000円
segments.tr: - From October 2029: Cap on solicitation expenses is 4,000 yen. If the return gift is similarly 3,000 yen, the budget available for other expenses is 1,000 yen

segments.src: 返礼品の調達費の上限（30%）は変わらないため、自治体は送料、梱包、決済手数料、ポータルサイトへの手数料といった「返礼品以外の経費」を圧縮する必要が出てきます。
segments.tr: Since the cap on return gift procurement costs (30%) remains unchanged, local governments will need to compress "expenses other than return gifts," such as shipping, packaging, payment processing fees, and portal site commissions.

segments.src: ## 地場産品の基準も厳格化される
segments.tr: ## Standards for Locally Produced Goods Also Being Tightened

segments.src: もう一つの変更点が、返礼品の「地場産品」の基準です。従来の「相応の付加価値が区域内で生じていること」という考え方が、「価値の過半が区域内で生じていること」という、より明確で厳しい形に整理されると報じられています。
segments.tr: Another change is the standard for "locally produced goods" as return gifts. It is reported that the conventional concept—"appropriate added value is generated within the region"—will be organized into a clearer and stricter form: "the majority of value is generated within the region."

segments.src: たとえば、原材料が他の地域産で、区域内では最終工程の加工や梱包だけを行っている返礼品などは、基準の見直しによって取り扱いが変わる可能性があります。ただし、どの返礼品が対象になるかは、自治体ごと、品目ごとに判断されます。基準が厳しくなったからといって、すぐに一律で掲載が終了するわけではありません。
segments.tr: For example, return gifts whose raw materials come from other regions and where only final processing or packaging is done within the area may see changes in how they are handled due to the standard review. However, which return gifts will be targeted will be decided on a municipal and item basis. Just because the standards have become stricter does not mean listings will immediately end across the board.

segments.src: ## 返礼品の選択肢にはどんな影響があるか
segments.tr: ## What Impact Will There Be on Return Gift Choices?

segments.src: 制度改正の影響は、自治体や返礼品の種類によって異なります。一般的には、次のような変化が考えられます。
segments.tr: The impact of the system revision varies depending on the local government and the type of return gift. Generally, the following changes can be expected:

segments.src: - **必要な寄付額が上がる、または内容量が減る**：送料や梱包費の負担が大きい冷凍品・大型品などで起こりやすい変化です。
segments.tr: - **Required donation amounts will increase, or content quantities will decrease**: This change is likely to occur with frozen foods, large items, and others where shipping and packaging costs place a heavy burden.

segments.src: - **一部の返礼品が掲載を終了する、内容を変更する**：地場産品基準への適合が難しい品目や、経費の見直しで採算が合わなくなった品目が対象になり得ます。
segments.tr: - **Some return gifts will end listings or change contents**: Items that are difficult to fit into the local product standards or items that become unprofitable due to expense reviews may be targeted.

segments.src: - **影響が小さい返礼品もある**：改正前から経費を抑えて運営してきた自治体や、地元で原材料の生産から加工まで完結している品目では、大きな変化がない場合もあります。
segments.tr: - **Some return gifts will see little impact**: There may be cases where there is no significant change in local governments that have kept expenses low even before the revision, or for items where everything from raw material production to processing is completed locally.

segments.src: なお、控除の対象となる年間上限額の計算方法は、今回の改正では変わらないとされています。負担が2,000円で済む範囲は、これまでと同じ考え方で決まります。
segments.tr: Note that the calculation method for the annual upper limit subject to deductions is said not to change with this revision. The range where the burden remains 2,000 yen will be determined by the same thinking as before.

segments.src: ## 9月末の「駆け込み寄付」は本当に得なのか
segments.tr: ## Is a Late-September "Last-Minute Donation" Really Worth It?

segments.src: ここが多くの人にとって最大の関心事でしょう。結論から言うと、「人によって異なる」というのが正確です。
segments.tr: This is likely the biggest concern for many people. To conclude, the accurate answer is that "it depends on the person."

segments.src: ### 駆け込みに意味があるケース
segments.tr: ### Cases Where Rushing Has Meaning

segments.src: - 現行の内容量と寄付額で、どうしても受け取りたい返礼品がすでに決まっている
segments.tr: - You have already decided on a return gift you definitely want to receive at the current content volume and donation amount

segments.src: - その返礼品について、自治体や寄付サイトが10月以降の終了・内容変更・寄付額の改定を予告している
segments.tr: - The local government or donation site has given advance notice of discontinuation, content changes, or donation amount revisions from October onward for that return gift

segments.src: - 年間の控除上限額に余裕があり、すでに寄付先も決まっている
segments.tr: - You have room in your annual deduction limit and have already decided where to donate

segments.src: このような場合は、条件が変わる前に申し込んでおく意味があります。
segments.tr: In such cases, it makes sense to apply before the conditions change.

segments.src: ### 急ぐ必要が小さいケース
segments.tr: ### Cases Where There Is Little Need to Hurry

segments.src: - **控除は「年単位」で計算される**：ふるさと納税の控除は、1月1日から12月31日までに行った寄付が同じ年分としてまとめて扱われます。控除を受ける面では、9月に寄付しても12月に寄付しても同じ年分です。
segments.tr: - **Deductions are calculated on an "annual basis"**: Furusato Nozei deductions group donations made from January 1 to December 31 together as the same year's share. In terms of receiving deductions, donating in September or December is the same tax year.

segments.src: - **控除上限額は変わらない**：今回の改正で上限額の算定は変わらないため、控除の面で「10月以降は不利になる」わけではありません。
segments.tr: - **Deduction limits do not change**: Because upper limit calculations do not change with this revision, it is not the case that things become "disadvantageous from October onward" in terms of deductions.

segments.src: - **すべての返礼品が変わるわけではない**：変更があるのは一部で、10月以降も条件が変わらない品目は少なくないと考えられます。
segments.tr: - **Not all return gifts will change**: Changes will only affect some items, and it is thought that quite a few items will not change conditions even after October.

segments.src: - **駆け込みには別のリスクがある**：月末は申し込みが集中し、在庫切れ、受付終了、発送の遅れ、サイトの混雑などが起こりやすくなります。また、決済の完了日や受付の締切はサイトによって異なるため、日付ぎりぎりの申し込みは避けたほうが安全です。
segments.tr: - **Rushing carries other risks**: Applications concentrate at the end of the month, making out-of-stock situations, application closures, shipping delays, and site congestion more likely to occur. Also, since payment completion dates and application deadlines differ by site, it is safer to avoid applications at the very last minute.

segments.src: - **上限額を超えるおそれがある**：年収の見込みが固まっていない時期に慌てて寄付すると、上限額を超えてしまい、自己負担が2,000円では済まなくなるおそれがあります。
segments.tr: - **There is a risk of exceeding the limit**: If you donate in a rush during a period when your income forecast is not firm, you might exceed your upper limit, risking a personal out-of-pocket burden that exceeds 2,000 yen.

segments.src: つまり、「9月中でなければ絶対に損をする」ということはありません。一方で、特定の返礼品に強い希望がある人にとっては、駆け込みが合理的な場合もあります。大切なのは、日付よりも中身で判断することです。
segments.tr: In short, it is not true that "you will definitely lose out unless it is during September." On the other hand, for people with strong preferences for specific return gifts, rushing may be rational. The important thing is to judge by the contents rather than the date.

segments.src: ## 寄付する前に確認したい5つのポイント
segments.tr: ## 5 Points to Check Before Donating

segments.src: 1. **年間の控除上限額を確認する**：源泉徴収票や各サイトのシミュレーターで、自分の目安額を把握しましょう。今年すでに寄付した金額も合算して考えます。
segments.tr: 1. **Check your annual deduction limit**: Understand your estimated target amount using withholding tax slips or site simulators. Also consider combining amounts already donated this year.

segments.src: 2. **返礼品の告知を確認する**：気になる返礼品のページや自治体の公式サイトに、10月以降の変更予定が載っていないか見ておきます。
segments.tr: 2. **Check return gift announcements**: Look at the pages of return gifts you are interested in or the local government's official website to see if scheduled changes from October onward are posted.

segments.src: 3. **寄付額あたりの内容を比べる**：同じ品目でも自治体によって内容量が異なります。10月以降の掲載内容と比較してから選ぶのも一つの方法です。
segments.tr: 3. **Compare contents per donation amount**: Content quantities differ by local government even for the same item. Comparing with listing details from October onward is one way to choose.

segments.src: 4. **申し込みの期限に余裕を持つ**：決済方法や締切日時は各サイトで異なります。ワンストップ特例制度を使う場合は、申請書の提出期限にも注意してください。
segments.tr: 4. **Keep leeway in application deadlines**: Payment methods and deadline dates vary by site. If you use the One-Stop Exception System, also pay attention to the application submission deadline.

segments.src: 5. **返礼品だけで選ばない**：寄付金の使い道や、その自治体が取り組む事業にも目を向けると、制度本来の趣旨に沿った選び方ができます。
segments.tr: 5. **Do not choose based solely on return gifts**: Looking closely at how the donations are used and the projects the local government works on allows you to make choices aligned with the original intent of the system.

segments.src: ## まとめ
segments.tr: ## Summary

segments.src: - 2026年10月1日から、募集経費の上限は寄付額の50%以下から47.5%以下に引き下げられ、自治体の手元に残る割合は52.5%以上になる。
segments.tr: - Starting October 1, 2026, the cap on solicitation expenses will be lowered from 50% or less of the donation amount to 47.5% or less, and the percentage remaining for the local government will become 52.5% or more.

segments.src: - 割合は毎年10月に2.5ポイントずつ引き上げられ、2029年10月に60%に達する予定である。
segments.tr: - The percentage is scheduled to be raised by 2.5 points every October, reaching 60% in October 2029.

segments.src: - 地場産品の基準も厳格化され、返礼品の内容量・寄付額・掲載状況が変わる可能性がある。
segments.tr: - Standards for locally produced goods will also be tightened, which may change return gift content volumes, donation amounts, and listing statuses.

segments.src: - 控除は年単位で計算され、上限額の考え方も変わらないため、9月中の寄付が誰にとっても得になるわけではない。
segments.tr: - Because deductions are calculated annually and the concept of upper limits does not change, donating in September does not make it advantageous for everyone.

segments.src: - 特定の返礼品に強い希望がある場合を除き、慌てず、上限額と返礼品の中身を確認してから判断するのが無難である。
segments.tr: - Except when you have a strong desire for a specific return gift, it is safer to make decisions without rushing, after checking your upper limit and the contents of the return gift.

segments.src: 制度は今後も見直しが続く可能性があります。最新の情報は、総務省の「ふるさと納税ポータルサイト」や、各自治体・寄付サイトの案内で確認してください。
segments.tr: The system may continue to see revisions in the future. Please check the latest information via the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications' "Furusato Nozei Portal Site" or guidance from individual local governments and donation sites.

segments.src: *本記事は一般的な情報提供を目的としたもので、特定の寄付や寄付サイトを推奨するものではありません。税の控除額や手続きなど個別の判断が必要な場合は、お住まいの自治体や税務署、税理士などの専門家にご相談ください。*
segments.tr: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not recommend any specific donations or donation sites. If individual judgment regarding tax deduction amounts or procedures is necessary, please consult experts such as your local government, tax office, or certified tax accountant.*
